description_en: Updates the enabled status of an address
description_zh: 根据传入参数修改地址启用状态
kebab_example: aliyun alidns update-cloud-gtm-address-enable-status --address-id addr-895182181143680000 --enable-status enable --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateCloudGtmAddressEnableStatus

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh-CN: Chinese

en-US: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果显示的语言。取值：

zh-CN：中文

en-US：英文
parameters.name: accept_language

parameters.help_en: A client-generated token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用户生成的请求token。用于保证请求的幂等性。该参数值可自定义，但是要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the address
parameters.help_zh: 地址的ID，地址唯一标识码
parameters.name: address_id

parameters.help_en:
The enabled status of the address:

enable: The address can be used for DNS resolution if its health check is normal.

disable: The address cannot be used for DNS resolution, regardless of its health check status
parameters.help_zh:
地址启用状态：
enable：启用，当前地址健康检查正常的情况下可参与解析。
disable： 禁用，当前地址不管健康检查是否正常，均不可参与解析
parameters.name: enable_status

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation was successful:

true: The operation was successful.

false: The operation failed
Success.description_zh:
修改地址启用状态操作是否成功：

true：操作成功。

false：操作失败
